rounds.text: V.L.Infraprojects Ltd is trading at a heavily discounted P/E of 5.14x [E1] and a P/B of 0.86x [E2], representing a steep discount to sector benchmarks of 13.85x and 2.27x respectively [E6, E7]. This valuation is disconnected from the company’s exceptional compounding history, evidenced by a 5-year sales growth of 37% and profit growth of 59% [E14, E17], alongside a robust 3-year profit growth of 56% [E18]. Operating efficiency remains strong with an ROCE of 22.4% and an ROE of 18.3% [E12, E13], comfortably beating sector medians of 13.6% for ROCE [E58] and -1.6% for profit growth [E56]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow model suggests massive intrinsic mispricing, leaving an 86.7% margin of safety where the current price implies an illogical -10.5% earnings growth [E40, E41]. Results are fundamentally improving with a net profit increase of 33% year-over-year, creating a disconnect where cautious sentiment overlooks tangible outperformance [E51, E54]. Conceded: the company pays no dividend [E47], negative operating cash flow stood at Rs -4 Cr in Mar 2026 [E29], and institutional holdings have experienced outflows [E36, E37, E53].
